memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's gate 8 (tests/run-all.sh) accepts --jobs auto to match its own invocation and is much faster than a bare sequential run-all.sh call; run-all.sh additionally serializes load-sensitive concurrency/timing suites (test-lake-build-guard.sh, test-run-all-parallel.sh, test-four-tier-conflict.sh, test-state-write-concurrency.sh, test-state-write-regen-timing.sh) first, before any parallel pool -- these are the suites most likely to flake under heavy concurrent sibling load during /orchestrate batches. When a full-gate run reports a gate-8 failure during a multi-sibling batch, check system load and whether the failing suite is one of these five before assuming a regression.

When editing agent-system/extensions/core/context/repo/project-overview.md, remember .claude/ is gitignored (.gitignore:6), so the mirrored deploy copy at .claude/context/repo/project-overview.md can never be git-added -- only cp it for byte-identity, and commit the source-store path alone. A plan task phrased as 'commit both paths' should be read as 'ensure both paths are identical', not literally both git-staged.
